title: ghost commands
description: add commands that don't really work but look like it for client to confuse your friends.
body:
add commands like:
/diamonds: wich will give you 64 ghost diamonds
/bedrock: wich will give you 1 ghost bedrock
/heal wich will give you 100 fake hearts
these commands don't actually work and are just for show to send screenshots to your friends.
it is a fully client side mod just to send confusing screenshots.
